annotations.title: Send a group flight quote request

description: Sends a prepared group flight enquiry to a human specialist, who replies by email with a written quote, usually within about 2 hours. Takes only the confirmation_token from preparing it; it returns a confirmation, not a price, and books or charges nothing.

confirmation_token.description: confirmation_token returned when this write was prepared. Valid for 15 minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for this request, such as a UUID. Calling again with the same key and the same arguments returns the first result instead of sending again. Kept for 24 hours.

name: egf_request_group_quote

domain.description: The market whose desk handles the enquiry.

reply_to.description: Where the quote will be emailed.

return_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Absent for one way.

status.description: The enquiry reached the specialist desk. Nothing is booked or charged.

title: Send a group flight quote request
